title: Largest Local Values in a Matrix
statement: Return an (n-2) by (n-2) matrix where each cell is the maximum value in the corresponding 3-by-3 window of the input grid.

title: Largest Local Values in a Matrix
statement: Return an (n-2) by (n-2) matrix where each cell is the maximum value in the corresponding 3-by-3 window of the input grid.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[][] largestLocal(int[][] grid){int n=grid.length;int[][] out=new int[n-2][n-2];for(int i=1;i<n-1;i++)for(int j=1;j<n-1;j++){int m=Integer.MIN_VALUE;for(int x=i-1;x<=i+1;x++)for(int y=j-1;y<=j+1;y++)m=Math.max(m,grid[x][y]);out[i-1][j-1]=m;}return out;} }

title: Minimum Recolors to Get K Consecutive Black Blocks
statement: Return the minimum number of white blocks that must be recolored so some substring of length k contains only black blocks.

title: Minimum Recolors to Get K Consecutive Black Blocks
statement: Return the minimum number of white blocks that must be recolored so some substring of length k contains only black blocks.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minimumRecolors(String blocks,int k){int black=0;for(int i=0;i<k;i++)if(blocks.charAt(i)=='B')black++;int best=k-black;for(int i=k;i<blocks.length();i++){if(blocks.charAt(i)=='B')black++;if(blocks.charAt(i-k)=='B')black--;best=Math.min(best,k-black);}return best;} }

title: Minimum Hours of Training to Win a Competition
statement: Return the minimum training hours needed so initial energy and experience exceed each opponent's corresponding values when encountered.

title: Minimum Hours of Training to Win a Competition
statement: Return the minimum training hours needed so initial energy and experience exceed each opponent's corresponding values when encountered.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minNumberOfHours(int initialEnergy,int initialExperience,int[] energy,int[] experience){int need=Math.max(0,Arrays.stream(energy).sum()+1-initialEnergy);int exp=initialExperience;for(int e:experience){if(exp<=e){need+=e-exp+1;exp=e+1;}exp+=e;}return need;} }

title: Removing Stars From a String
statement: Process the string where each '*' removes the closest preceding non-star character, and return the remaining string.
approach_name: Stack removes the nearest preceding character
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String removeStars(String s){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='*')b.deleteCharAt(b.length()-1);else b.append(c);}return b.toString();} }

title: Most Frequent Even Element
statement: Return the even number with the highest frequency, choosing the smallest number when frequencies tie; return -1 if there is no even number.

title: Most Frequent Even Element
statement: Return the even number with the highest frequency, choosing the smallest number when frequencies tie; return -1 if there is no even number.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int mostFrequentEven(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer> f=new HashMap<>();for(int x:nums)if(x%2==0)f.put(x,f.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);int ans=-1,best=0;for(var e:f.entrySet())if(e.getValue()>best||(e.getValue()==best&&(ans==-1||e.getKey()<ans))){ans=e.getKey();best=e.getValue();}return ans;} }

title: Sort the People
statement: Return the names sorted from tallest to shortest.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String[] sortPeople(String[] names,int[] heights){Integer[] idx=new Integer[names.length];for(int i=0;i<idx.length;i++)idx[i]=i;Arrays.sort(idx,(a,b)->Integer.compare(heights[b],heights[a]));String[] out=new String[names.length];for(int i=0;i<idx.length;i++)out[i]=names[idx[i]];return out;} }

title: Number of Common Factors

approach_name: Count divisors up to the smaller number

title: Number of Common Factors
statement: Return the number of positive integers that divide both a and b.
approach_name: Count divisors up to the smaller number
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int commonFactors(int a,int b){int c=0;for(int x=1;x<=Math.min(a,b);x++)if(a%x==0&&b%x==0)c++;return c;} }

title: The Employee That Worked on the Longest Task
statement: Given employees' task end times in chronological order, return the employee ID with the longest single task; choose the smallest ID on a tie.
approach_name: Compare durations and break ties by smaller employee ID
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int hardestWorker(int n,int[][] logs){int id=logs[0][0],best=logs[0][1],prev=logs[0][1];for(int i=1;i<logs.length;i++){int emp=logs[i][0],end=logs[i][1],d=end-prev;if(d>best||(d==best&&emp<id)){best=d;id=emp;}prev=end;}return id;} }
